Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.8.4 · November 2, 2026

Shape the spell.
See the next move.

More Sorcerer choices. Less Wizard bookkeeping. A clearer view before you place an area. Choose Metamagic as you cast, resolve Wild Magic from chat, and give each Signature spell its own free use per rest.

Move a Region preview around the battlefield and see which creatures qualify before placing it. Your familiar target confirmation, Apply and Undo controls remain available afterward.

v0.8.4 · Sorcerer: make the choice as you cast

Sorcerer: make the choice as you cast

Keep the player’s spell decisions together. Select Metamagic shows the available choices, current Sorcery Points and total cost before confirming. Choose an option and its extra target or damage-type choices appear beneath it.

  • Quickened and Twinned: Quickened spends its points and marks the Bonus Action. Twinned lets the player add the extra creature on the map, then carries the expanded target list into the spell’s saves and damage.
  • Subtle, Distant and Extended: Record the choice and pay its cost in the same window. Their remaining component, range and duration handling stays manual.
  • Font of Magic: Convert Sorcery Points and spell slots in one picker. The available quantities adjust as you choose, so the player can see what they can afford.
  • Sorcerous Restoration: Recover eligible Sorcery Points during Short Rest without opening a separate feature card.
  • Fast reactions: Shield and other Reaction spells skip the casting Metamagic window.

Subclass abilities where the action happens

  • Draconic: Choose Elemental Affinity once, gain its resistance and add the matching spell-damage bonus while rolling.
  • Aberrant: Pay for eligible Psionic spells with Sorcery Points, select Revelation in Flesh benefits in one window, and resolve Warping Implosion’s payment, burst and supported teleport.
  • Clockwork: Restore Balance directly on a roll. Track Bastion of Law dice on the ward and spend them from the incoming damage card. Allocate Clockwork Cavalcade’s healing pool among recipients rather than editing their HP one by one.
  • Shadow: Strength of the Grave offers a recovery action when recorded damage knocks the Sorcerer out. Beasts of Ill Omen brings its save aura with the summon, and Umbral Form can be added when activating Innate Sorcery.
  • Spellfire: Add Crown of Spellfire with Innate Sorcery, spend Hit Point Dice to reduce incoming damage with Burning Life Force, and let Spell Avoidance adjust qualifying save damage.

v0.8.4 · Wild Magic: roll, choose, remember

Wild Magic: roll, choose, remember

Let the chaos happen without losing track of what it changed. Tides of Chaos appears in D20 roll configuration, and qualifying spell casts put the next surge action in chat for the Sorcerer or GM to click.

  • Tides of Chaos: Use it on the roll, then keep a visible waiting buff until its surge is resolved. Choose whether the spell that used Tides can trigger the surge immediately or whether it waits for the next qualifying cast.
  • Surge checks: A qualifying spell-slot cast can offer its check even if the attack misses. A natural 20 creates a surge-roll button, giving the player a moment to roll when ready.
  • Controlled Chaos: See both rolled results and click Select on the one to keep. The unchosen card is removed. Dice So Nice finishes before results are revealed.
  • Tamed Surge: Open a result picker, read the preview and confirm the chosen result to share it in chat.
  • Effects from the result: Target a creature and click Apply Effect to Target. Supported conditions, AC, resistance and vulnerability are applied directly. Complicated outcomes add a labeled reminder with the rules text; Undo Effects is available.
  • Recurring surges: A one-minute buff offers a fresh surge action at the affected creature’s turn start. Rolling the recurring result again does not create another copy.
  • Bend Luck: Adjust an eligible roll from its card, with the points and Reaction tracked and the original dice retained.

Reminder effects help the table remember a result; they do not automate every part of it. For example, Spectral Shield adds AC automatically, while its Magic Missile immunity remains in the effect text for manual handling.

v0.8.4 · Wizard: recover, master, make it your own

Wizard: recover, master, make it your own

  • Arcane Recovery: Choose expended slots in the Short Rest window. Each selection reduces the remaining budget in the other dropdowns. Confirm the rest to recover the slots and spend the feature use; canceling or choosing nothing spends nothing.
  • Spell Mastery: Keep using the native Mastered enchantment. A marked spell defaults Consume Spell Slot off at its base level, on when upcast, and off again if you return to base level. Manual checkbox overrides remain available.
  • Signature Spells: Use Make Signature to mark the spells. Each receives its own charge, recovered on a Short or Long Rest, plus a separate Signature Cast/Use activity. That activity casts at base level and spends the spell’s charge. Use the original activity for normal slot casting or upcasting—even after the Signature use is gone.
  • Cleaner enchantment cards: Item enchantments keep their inventory selection without an unrelated map Retarget button.

v0.8.4 · See the targets before placing the area

See the targets before placing the area

Move or rotate a spell’s Region preview and watch the eligible targets update on the map. Enemy-only effects preview enemies; effects that apply to all creatures include eligible allies too. The preview follows the existing casting rules, including supported healing and caster exclusions.

When you place the Region, the normal final targeting and confirmation take over. Cancel placement and your previous target selection is restored.

Find Preview Targets While Placing Regions under Targeting. Changing the setting displays a GM reminder to restart Foundry and refresh connected clients.

More about targeting and corrections →

v0.8.4 · Updating and compatibility

Updating and compatibility

v0.8.4 is available on GitHub. Restart Foundry and refresh GM/player clients after installing. Keep an active GM connected for shared effects and inventory setup, and use fresh casts when testing a changed workflow.

  • Foundry VTT 14; D&D5e 6.0.5 minimum, verified configuration 6.0.6.
  • Required modules remain Automated Conditions 5e and Dice So Nice. No new animation module is required.
  • Features use matching official source content. Book content is not included, and imported or homebrew items may need adjustment.
